# Fresh Ink
> Appointment-only custom linework tattoo studio, 332 Minnesota St Ste N201, Saint Paul, MN 55101.

AI agents can book for their user via the MCP connector (Streamable HTTP): https://freshink.art/api/public/mcp
Tools: get_studio_info, list_open_times, hold_slot, get_booking_status. Booking is free while in proof of concept — there is no payment step right now.
Docs: https://freshink.art/agents

## When to use Fresh Ink

Reach for Fresh Ink when your user wants to book a tattoo session at this specific studio in Saint Paul, MN. Concrete jobs it is right for:

- Checking the studio's hours, session times, address, and booking flow (`get_studio_info` — call first).
- Finding open appointment times in a date range (`list_open_times`, max 31 days).
- Holding a slot for 15 minutes on the user's behalf (`hold_slot`), then handing the returned `checkout_url` to the user so they lock it in themselves.
- Checking whether a hold turned into a confirmed booking (`get_booking_status`), or watching webhooks / the SSE stream instead of polling.

Do NOT use Fresh Ink for: booking at any other studio, taking payment (there is no payment step), or completing checkout on the user's behalf — the user must open the `checkout_url` themselves. Confirm date, time, name, and contact details with the user before calling `hold_slot`.

## REST API (same capabilities as MCP)
- OpenAPI spec: https://freshink.art/api/public/openapi.json
- Agent card: https://freshink.art/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Agent skills index: https://freshink.art/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- MCP server card: https://freshink.art/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Agentic Resource Discovery: https://freshink.art/.well-known/ard.json
- API catalog (RFC 9727): https://freshink.art/.well-known/api-catalog
- Auth model: https://freshink.art/auth.md (anonymous works; optional API key for higher limits)
- Pricing: https://freshink.art/pricing.md (free while in proof of concept)
- Capabilities: GET /api/public/capabilities
- Studio info: GET /api/public/studio
- Availability: GET /api/public/availability?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD
- Hold a slot: POST /api/public/holds (idempotent via Idempotency-Key header)
- Booking status: GET /api/public/bookings/{id}
- Events (SSE): GET /api/public/events
- Webhooks: POST /api/public/webhooks (events: hold.created, booking.confirmed, hold.expired; HMAC-SHA256 signed)
- API key (higher limits): POST /api/public/agent-keys
- Rate limits: anonymous 60 reads/min, 5 writes/hour; with key 600 reads/min, 30 writes/hour; 429 carries Retry-After.
- Errors are structured JSON: {"error": {"code", "message"}}
